block_node.block_desc:
Combine a set of signals into an AXI interface compatible bus.
The block accepts control signals and outputs a bus.
Set the Control protocol parameter to the desired protocol interface type.

Convert a set of control signals from an AXI interface compatible bus.
The block accepts a bus and outputs control signals.
Set the Control protocol parameter to the desired protocol interface type.

Implement a first-in, first-one (FIFO) to control the backpressure between upstream and downstream hardware logic data interfaces.
The block accepts data and valid signals from the upstream interface, and outputs a ready signal to that interface. The block outputs data and valid signals to the downstream data interface and accepts a ready signal from that interface.
Set the Almost full threshold parameter to output a ready signal value of FALSE when FIFO capacity reaches the specified threshold.

Implement a first-in, first-out (FIFO) to control the backpressure between upstream and downstream hardware logic video interfaces.
The block accepts pixel and control signals from the upstream interface, and outputs a ready signal to that interface. The block outputs pixel and control signals to the downstream video interface and accepts a ready signal from that interface.
Set the Almost full threshold parameter to output a ready signal value of FALSE when FIFO capacity reaches the specified threshold.

Connect two hardware logic IP cores using an AXI4-Stream interface.
The block accepts data, valid and last signals from the upstream data interface and outputs a ready signal. The block outputs data, valid and last signals to the downstream interface and accepts a ready signal.

Connect two hardware logic IP cores using an AXI4-Stream video interface.
The block accepts data and control signals from the upstream video interface and outputs a control signal to that interface. The block outputs data and control signals to the downstream video interface and accepts a control signal from that interface.
